questions.question:
If the mean of the following data is 9, then find the value of k.

11, (k - 2), 7, (k - 1), 11, 16, 12, 15, (k - 1), 13
questions.solution:
**Given**

Mean = 9

11, (k-2), 7, (k-1), 11, 16, 12, 15, (k-1), 13

**Formula used**

Mean = Sum of all observation/Number of observation

**Calculation**

9 = [11+ (k - 2) + 7+ (k - 1) + 11 + 16 + 12 + 15 + (k - 1) + 13]/10

⇒ 90 = (85 + 3k - 4)

⇒ 90 + 4 = 85 + 3k

⇒ 94 - 85 = 3k

⇒ 9 = 3k

⇒ k = 3

**∴ The value of k is 3.**

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio (4)/(9) ∶ (2)/(3) ∶ (3)/(4). The difference between the greatest and the smallest numbers is 33. Find the greatest number.
questions.solution:
**Given**

(4/9) ∶ (2/3) ∶ (3/4)

**Concept**

First convert the denominator of all the fractions same by taking the L.C.M of the denominator of all the given numbers

**Calculation**

let the numbers are (4x/9), (2x/3) and (3x/4)

L.C.M of 9,3 and 4 is 36

(4 × 4)/(9 × 4) = 16x/36

(2 × 12)/(3 × 12) = 24x/36

(3 × 9)/(4 × 9) = 27x/36

greatest number = 27x/36

smallest number = 16x/36

According to question

(27x/36) - (16x/36) = 33

⇒ 11x/36 = 33

⇒ x = ( 33 × 36)/11

⇒ x = 108

greatest number is (27 × 108)/36

⇒ 81

**∴ The greatest number is 81**

questions.question: Kamala has three cylindrical containers, each with radius 20 cm that she wants to fill with grain. If her bag of grain contains 100 kg of grain, and she fills all three containers to a height of 70 cm, how much grain will be left in the bag, if 1 kg grain occupies 3000 cm³ space? The radius of cylindrical container = 20 cm

Quantity of grain in a bag = 100 kg

**Formula used**

The volume of cylindrical container = πr²h

where r and h are the radius and height of the cylindrical container respectively

**Calculation**

Volume of conatiner = (22/7) × 20 ×20 × 70

⇒ 22 × 400 × 10

⇒ 88000 cm³

Three cylindrical container contain = 3 × 88000

⇒ 264000 cm³

Quantity left in bag = (100 × 3000) - 264000

⇒ 3,00,000 - 2,64,000

⇒ 36,000 cm³

1 kg = 3000 cm³ (Given)

so, 1 cm³ = (1/3000) kg

⇒ 36,000 cm³ = (1/3000) × 36,000

⇒ 12 Kg

questions.question: A square park has area 4356 m². Taking its one round is same as taking one round of another circular park. Find the area of the circular park. (Use π = frac{{22}}{7})
questions.solution:
**Given**

Area of square park = 4356 m²

**Formula used**

Area of square = (side)²

Perimeter of square = 4 × side

Circumference of circle = 2πr

where r is radius of circle

**Calculation**

Area of square = (side)²

4356 = (side)²

⇒ 66 m = side

Perimeter of square park = 4 × side

⇒ 4 × 66

⇒ 264 m

Circumference of circular park = 2πr

264 = 2 × (22/7) × r

⇒ r = (264 × 7)/(2 × 22)

⇒ r = 42

Area of circular park = πr²

⇒ (22/7) × (42) × (42)

⇒ 22 × 6 × 42

⇒ 132 × 42

⇒ 5544 m²

**∴ Area of circular park is 5544 m²**

questions.question: For a 14-day camp, sufficient supplies are available for 300 people. 50 more people arrive on day 1 itself. For how many days will these supplies be sufficient for all these people?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Number of days food available = 14

Number of people = 300

Number of people increased = 350

**Concept**

Indirect variation

If on the increase of one quantity say x the other quantity,say y decreases to same extent or vice versa, then, it is an indirect variation.

x₁y₁ = x₂y₂

**Calculation**

As number of person increased from 300 to 350, so the food available for less number of days.

let food available for number of days is x and number of person is y

x₁y₁ = x₂y₂

14 × 300 = 350 × x₂ 

⇒ x₂ = (14 × 300)/350

⇒ x₂ = 12

**∴ Supply of food will be sufficient for 12 days.**

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 140. If their LCM is 240 and HCF is 20, then find the smaller number.
questions.solution:
**Given**

sum of two numbers = 140

L.C.M= 240

HCF = 20

**Concept**

Product of two numbers = Product of L.C.M and H.C.F

**Calculation**

Let the one number is x and second number is (140 - x)

x × (140 - x) = 240 × 20

⇒ 140x - x² = 4800

⇒ -x² + 140x - 4800 = 0

⇒ x² - 140x + 4800 = 0

⇒ x² - 60x - 80x + 4800 = 0

⇒ x(x - 60) - 80(x - 60) = 0

⇒ (x - 60) (x - 80) = 0

⇒ x = 60 and 80

**∴ Smaller number is 60.**
